template.staff_sick_subject: [Important] Temporary closure due to staff illness
template.staff_sick_body:
Thank you for your continued patronage.

We regret to inform you that due to staff illness,
we will be closed on __PERIOD__.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused to customers with reservations.

Please contact us to rebook your appointment.
template.maintenance_subject: [Important] Temporary closure due to equipment maintenance
template.maintenance_body:
Thank you for your continued patronage.

We regret to inform you that due to equipment maintenance,
we will be closed on __PERIOD__.

We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your understanding.

Please contact us to rebook your appointment.
template.emergency_body:
Thank you for your continued patronage.

We regret to inform you that due to weather or an emergency,
we will be closed on __PERIOD__.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused to customers with reservations.

We will contact you again once the situation improves.

guide.title: How to use My Reservations
guide.description: On this page you can see a list of the slots you have booked, along with the current status of each one.

overview.title: What is My Reservations
overview.body: This page lists the slots you have booked. You can tell at a glance whether each one is approved and when it is scheduled.

steps.step1: When you open the page, your reservations load automatically.
steps.step2: Each card shows the bookable item name, date, and start–end time.

status.title: Reading the status
status.body: The colored badge on each reservation card shows the current status of that reservation.

items.item3: Blue "Completed" … The slot has been used.
items.item5: Gray "No-show" … The slot was not used on the reserved day.

empty.title: When no reservations are shown
empty.body: What to do when you have no reservations, or when loading fails.

steps.step1: If "No reservations" is shown, you simply have no reservations yet.
steps.step2: If "Failed to load reservations" is shown, it is a connection error. Please reload the page.

message.cancel_deadline_passed: The cancellation deadline has passed, so this reservation could not be cancelled. If you need to change it, please contact a team administrator

empty.no_available_slots: No available slots on this day

book.admin_no_lines_hint: Create reservation targets and slots in "Manage reservation targets" to show slots here
book.admin_no_slots: No open slots on this day
book.admin_no_slots_hint: You can add slots from "Manage reservation targets"
book.member_no_lines_hint: Please wait until the administrator prepares reservation slots
book.member_no_slots: No open slots on this day

line.delete_guide: Deleting this will stop the slot template for this line, and any future slots without reservations will be removed automatically. If there are active reservations, please reschedule or cancel them first.

resource_name.deputy_hint: Deputy admins can only change what bookable items are called. Managing lines, menus, and so on is done by admins.

allow_public.label: Allow non-member reservations
allow_public.hint_off: Currently only members (MEMBER or above) can make reservations
allow_public.confirm_enable: Non-members will be able to make reservations. Continue?
allow_public.confirm_disable: Non-members will no longer be able to make reservations. Continue?

approval_mode.label: Approval Mode
approval_mode.hint: AUTO = reservations confirmed immediately / MANUAL = admin must approve manually

cancel_deadline.label: Cancellation Deadline
cancel_deadline.hint: How many hours before the reservation can the user cancel (0 = until start, 8760 = always allowed)

remind.label: Reminder Timing (CSV)
remind.hint: Comma-separated hours before the reservation to send reminders (e.g. 24,1)
remind.error_empty: Please enter at least one value
remind.error_invalid: Enter integers between 0 and 8760 separated by commas

book.not_affiliated_notice: Reservations for this team are for members only
book.not_affiliated_hint: Please join the team or contact the administrator
book.error_public_forbidden: Reservations are only available to team members

field.title: Title (optional)
field.capacity_hint: Maximum number of reservations for this slot (default 1 = 1:1 booking)

approval_mode.label: Approval Mode
approval_mode.hint: Use team setting = inherit default policy / Auto-confirm = instant / Manual = admin approval required

unavailability.help: Register time ranges when reservations cannot be accepted, such as temporary closures or staff days off. Choosing a template auto-fills the time range from business hours (you can adjust it afterward). Before registering, you are warned if existing reservations fall within that range.

staff.label: Reservation target (staff)
staff.hint: Targets without a default staff member cannot be selected.

field.time_range_hint: Leave blank to block the entire day.

template.label: Template
template.no_business_hours: Business hours are not set, so times cannot be auto-filled. Please enter the time range manually.

impact.warning: There are {count} reservations in this time range. You can register after rescheduling or cancelling them.
impact.hint: You cannot register while reservations remain.

error.has_active_reservations: Reservations remain in this time range, so it cannot be registered. Please reschedule or cancel them and try again.

notify_recipients.help: Register email addresses that are notified whenever a reservation is made. You can add addresses that are not app users, such as your shop's main address. The free plan allows up to 3 addresses; a paid plan is required from the 4th (up to 10).
notify_recipients.pii_notice: Registered addresses receive the booker's name, arrival date/time, and menu. Take care when registering addresses that are shared externally.

paid_lock.title: The free plan allows up to {free} addresses
paid_lock.detail: Upgrade to a paid plan to register the 4th and beyond (up to {max}).

notify_recipients.limit_reached: You can register up to {max} addresses. No more can be added.

error.paid_required_detail: The free plan allows up to 3 recipients. Upgrade to a paid plan to register the 4th and beyond.
error.limit_exceeded: You can register up to {limit} recipients.
error.duplicate: This email address is already registered.
error.invalid_email: The email address format is invalid.

menu.price_display_only: Price is for display only and is not charged
menu.line_scope_note: Reservation targets added later are not automatically added to menus with a restricted offering scope
menu.limit_reached: You can register up to 20 menus
menu.duration_invalid: Duration must be in 30-minute increments, between 30 minutes and 8 hours
menu.empty_state_hint: Use "Add menu" to create a menu with a duration
menu.line_ids_invalid: The selected reservation targets are invalid. Check whether any deleted reservation targets are included
menu.line_not_available: This menu is not offered for the selected reservation target

template.limit_reached: You can register up to 500 templates
template.empty_state_hint: Use "Add template" to set a day of week and time range — slots are created automatically as soon as you save

error.day_required: Please select a day of week
error.time_range_invalid: Start time must be before end time, in 30-minute increments

template.generated_zero_hint: No slots were created (outside business hours or a closed day). Please check your business hours

recurring_block.title: Weekly unavailability
recurring_block.reason_no_pii: Do not include personal names or customer information in the reason (it will be shown to all members)
recurring_block.is_public_note: When ON, this label is shown on the availability view
recurring_block.limit_reached: You can register up to 50 recurring unavailability rules
recurring_block.full_day_hint: To close all day, set the day as a regular closed day in business hours instead
recurring_block.impact_warning: There are {n} overlapping reservations in the next 90 days
recurring_block.day_empty: No unavailability rules for this day

message.load_failed: Failed to load recurring unavailability rules

error.toggle_conflict: Could not pause/resume — there are overlapping reservations in this time slot

business_hours.title: Business hours
business_hours.generation_failed: Business hours were saved, but the automatic slot update failed. It will catch up automatically tomorrow morning
business_hours.shrink_note: Already-created future slots for this day will remain as they are (they will not be closed retroactively). To permanently close a specific date, use "Close this day" in the exception day calendar

exception_day.title: Exception day calendar
exception_day.help: Pick a date on the calendar to close it, or to open specially on a day that is normally closed.
exception_day.close_day_impact_warning: There are {n} active reservations on this day
exception_day.notify_hint: If you need to notify reservers, use emergency closure instead
exception_day.blocked_conflict: This day is set to closed. Cancel the closure before running this
exception_day.date_range_hint: Special openings can be set from tomorrow up to 90 days ahead

grid.title: Availability grid
grid.help: Rows are time slots and columns are {resourceName}. Tap a green "Open" cell to book. Grey or hatched cells cannot be booked. Use the "Week" tab to view seven days at once.

matrix.title: Availability matrix
matrix.cannot_start_here: You can't book {menu} starting here (not enough consecutive slots)
matrix.cannot_extend: You can't extend any further (the next slot isn't open, or you've reached the 8-hour limit)
matrix.no_menu_single: Book just 30 minutes without a menu
matrix.help_body: Tap an open (green) time slot, then choose a menu — the required number of slots is selected automatically. Use "+30 min" to add more. If you pick a shared slot, choose which {resourceName} to book it for.
matrix.slot_unavailable_conflict: This time slot isn't accepting bookings right now. Please try another time

group.title: Group booking
group.extend_hint: You can extend if the following slot is open
group.conflict_retry: Someone else booked first. We've refreshed availability — please choose again
group.not_consecutive: The selected slots aren't consecutive or don't match the target
group.size_exceeded: A booking group can have at most 16 slots
group.row_locked: This is a group booking. Please manage it as a group
group.deadline_passed: The cancellation deadline has passed, so this can't be cancelled
group.own_overlap: You already have another booking in the selected time slot. Please check the time

matrix_steps.1: Colors: green "Available" = bookable / "Booked" = taken / diagonal stripes = "Unavailable" / pale gray = "Closed".

filter_steps.0: Use the menu filter at the top to highlight the exact number of slots that menu needs.
filter_steps.1: Without a menu, you can book single 30-minute slots one at a time.

flow_steps.1: Choosing a menu automatically groups the required number of slots (skipped automatically if a menu filter is already applied).
flow_steps.2: Press "+30 min" if you want to extend the time.
flow_steps.3: Review the date/details, fill in "Notes (optional)", and press "Confirm this booking" to finish.

conflict_steps.0: Gray cells ("Booked", "Closed", or "Unavailable") can't be selected. Choose another time or {resourceName}.
conflict_steps.1: If someone else takes the same slot right before you confirm, you'll see an error and the screen auto-refreshes to the latest availability. Please choose an open slot again.

admin_overview_steps.0: Filter by status (pending, approved, cancelled, completed, no show).
admin_overview_steps.1: Multi-slot "group bookings" appear as a single row that shows the slot count.

admin_manage_steps.0: In teams with manual approval, approve or reject pending reservations.
admin_manage_steps.1: Confirmed reservations can also be cancelled. Group bookings are managed as a group.
admin_manage_steps.2: These actions instantly update availability on the "Reserve" tab.

member_mine_steps.0: Only your own reservations appear here (other members' reservations are never shown).
member_mine_steps.1: Filter by status to check them.

member_cancel_steps.0: Press "Cancel" on the reservation row you want to withdraw, then press "Cancel" again on the confirmation screen.
member_cancel_steps.1: Past the cancellation deadline an error is shown and you can't cancel it yourself — contact a team administrator if you need a change.

setup0_steps.0: In "Business hours" set the hours you're open for each day of the week. This is the foundation slots are built on.
setup0_steps.1: As soon as you save, slots for the next 28 days are created automatically.

setup1_steps.0: Use "Add {resourceName}" at the top of this tab to register seats, staff, or counters that can be booked.
setup1_steps.1: Without {resourceName}, the "Reserve" tab shows nothing to members.

setup2_steps.0: In "Manage menus" below, register menus with a duration (in 30-minute units).
setup2_steps.1: To limit a menu to specific {resourceName}, choose "Only selected {resourceName}" under "Bookable Item" and pick them (the default offers it on every {resourceName}).

setup3_steps.0: In "Weekly schedule" below, set the day of week, time range, and capacity — slots are created automatically as long as it's within business hours.
setup3_steps.1: As soon as you save, slots for the next 28 days are created automatically.
setup3_steps.2: After that, slots keep extending automatically every day — no action needed.

daily_steps.0: Once the weekly schedule is set up, slots keep extending automatically every day, so there's normally nothing to do.
daily_steps.1: Edit the weekly schedule only when you want to change the day or time range.

exception_steps.0: To close a specific day or open it specially, use "Close this day" / "Open specially" in the exception day calendar. To fine-tune individual slots, use "Manually manage individual slots" under Advanced settings to create, edit, or close them.
exception_steps.1: To block a specific time range from being booked, use "Unavailable ranges" in advanced settings.
exception_steps.2: Deleting {resourceName} stops its template and auto-deletes its future slots with no reservations. If it still has active reservations, reassign or cancel them first.

emergency_closure.send_title: What happens when you send it

send_steps.0: Everyone with a reservation in the affected period/time range gets an email and in-app notification about the closure.
send_steps.1: Checking "Cancel affected reservations" also automatically cancels the reservations in the affected period.

status_steps.0: Open the send history to see, in real time, who has confirmed (read) the notice.
status_steps.1: The "n/m confirmed" display means n out of m recipients have confirmed.
